headline: Prudential (NYSE:PRU) Reports Q4 CY2025 In Line With Expectations
summary: Financial services giant Prudential Financial (NYSE:PRU) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 11.6% year on year to $14.52 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.30 per share was 1.9% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
